workflow: Put the milk back — normative placement in the EASE apartment
gap: put_back(milk M: table → belonging_place(M, state)) under belonging(M | context), restoration_obligation(M), critics{completeness, relational, physical, safety, accessibility, workflow, convention}

entries.detail: Perceive the milk and its state; propose candidate destinations from the belonging store. Three states select three destinations: table_area_main / cabinet7 / recycling_zone.

constraints.text: Belonging is contextual: milk resolves to table_area_main (in_use_during_breakfast), cabinet7 (opened_nonempty_after_breakfast), recycling_zone (empty_recyclable_carton) by state — observation frequency alone is insufficient

entries.detail: Translate the resolved belonging norm into an explicit placement designator: Place(milk) = ⟨table_area_main, on, region, pose, breakfast_use, constraints, evidence⟩.

constraints.text: Most-confident applicable norm selected: table_area_main : on (confidence 0.75)

entries.detail: Ground the designator in the semantic digital twin: select an admissible placement region (reachability ∩ support ∩ visibility) and a stable pose on the table.

constraints.text: Placement region = support(table) ∩ reachable(pr2) ∩ visible; stable, collision-free pose grounded at (5.1, 3.3)

entries.detail: Run the critic suite over the grounded candidate. All seven dimensions pass; the placement is admissible and warranted.

constraints.text: completeness · relational · physical · safety — all pass

entries.detail: Commit the reason-warranted placement and open a restoration obligation: the milk's stable relation (inside cold storage) is disturbed under the breakfast license.

constraints.text: verdict(milk @ table, breakfast active) = LICENSED — licensed, not misplaced
Disturbance of stable relation (milk inside cabinet7) caused by ROBOT → prima-facie warrant; restoration obligation opened, status LICENSED

entries.detail: Execute the transport and monitor object identity, grasp, support and release until the milk rests on the table.

constraints.text: Runtime monitors: object identity ∧ grasp ∧ support ∧ release — held; at(milk, table) established

entries.detail: The obligation persists past the placement. When breakfast ends the license lapses, the obligation becomes dischargeable, and the same on-table milk would read MISPLACED — driving a state-mediated return to cold storage.

constraints.text: Counterfactual — breakfast ended (no license): verdict(milk @ table) = MISPLACED; discharge via state_mediated_return

entries.detail: Record the episode as a tamper-evident, hash-chained trace: belonging resolution, verdict, obligation, and critic verdicts become NEEM evidence.

constraints.text: A single successful placement is evidence, not proof — logged as a scoped competence claim (NEEM, hash-chained)
